beats.title: Two women, two men
beats.detail: The four leave together; Aditi leads bolder-than-EP02 double-meaning flirting, and Avi/Yash each tease both women. Meenakshi participates rather than just watching.

beats.title: One-glass challenge
beats.detail: Meenakshi first refuses alcohol, then freely agrees to one glass of wine after light group encouragement. Other three drink more moderately. Her one glass is taken at the start, but does not justify driving later.

beats.title: Aditi sets the temperature

beats.title: Yash joins

beats.title: Meenakshi joins later
beats.detail: The group invites her and she chooses to dance. Avi notices the fitted kurta and her peach-rounded hip curve as she crosses the floor; Yash notices her hourglass waist, steps and changes of expression. Their distinct private glances are visual observations, not permission; Aditi also notices the change in the group's attention.

beats.title: Who sits next to Meenakshi?
beats.detail: With a sober driver at the wheel, the only rear seat beside Meenakshi becomes contested. Yash takes it before Avi; Avi takes the front passenger seat. Meenakshi and Aditi see the rivalry and laugh, then Aditi leaves.

beats.title: Unspoken looks

These are distinct, private adult-admiration metaphors; each man exchanges a teasing glance, and Meenakshi does not know exactly what was noticed.

beats.title: Fitness-flirt challenge
beats.detail: A playful abs/fitness conversation becomes a voluntary challenge. Meenakshi explicitly offers limited clothed abdomen contact, individually for Avi and Yash; she assumes the contact stays over clothing.

beats.title: Yash's unexpected direct contact
beats.detail: A shift of Meenakshi's seat posture while retrieving her phone lifts the edge of the plum kurta. Yash's fingers accidentally slip just under the edge toward her abdomen, differing from her assumption of over-clothing contact. She is briefly surprised and tense; he pauses and checks her comfort. She consciously agrees to continued direct abdomen contact for up to about one minute. Her reaction is private and conflicted; do not portray her silence as consent or turn the outline into explicit prose.

beats.title: Quiet aftermath
beats.detail: The encounter ends; they adjust posture and say little. No escalation or kiss. The car resumes toward the drop-off.

beats.title: Avi jokingly kicks Yash
beats.detail: Both men exit. Avi mock-jealously gives Yash a light, playful kick for the seating/attention rivalry; Yash jokes back. Meenakshi sees them from the car and smiles shyly.

beats.title: Three memories — not home yet
beats.detail: Meenakshi continues toward home with the sober driver. Her mind moves among Naveen's unresolved afternoon continuation, Avi's open flirtation/jealousy, Yash's closer personal encounter, and her awareness of the wine. Stop before home arrival.
